idea-plugin.name: Light Code
idea-plugin.description:
A minimal agentic coding assistant, for working inside an organisation.
  • Your own gateway: mutual TLS, client certificates, OAuth client-credentials, header auth.
  • An agent team — expert, programmer, reviewer, tester, librarian — each backed by a different model, consulting each other.
  • MCP tools, dynamic Python tools, skills shared across a team.
  • Technical diagrams, charts, and indexed search over your own data.
  • No telemetry, no default endpoints. Nothing is contacted that you did not configure.
Works in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm and the other IntelliJ-based IDEs.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• Light Code 0.113.0: the @ picker says when nothing matches.
  • Light Code 0.112.0: @codebase-name on its own, a saved credential for a search connection's username, full names on hover in dropdowns.
  • Light Code 0.111.0: the handbook covers Fire Code (formerly Sun Code).
  • Light Code 0.110.0: a config saved with a byte-order mark is read; a shell command naming a file changed since it was read waits for a re-read.
  • Light Code 0.109.0: @ always finds the file you mean in a large codebase; the handbook covers Fire Code's schedule timetable.
  • Light Code 0.108.0: code in chat is highlighted again, in VS Code's colours; notify can attach a report file (.md or .html); white text on teal accents; a Review icon of its own.
  • Light Code 0.107.0: after every edit the assistant sees the errors and warnings its change produced, from language servers installed on this machine (Python, Java, Kotlin, TypeScript, Go and more), and a get_diagnostics tool checks any file without a build; an edit made from a stale read is refused; rollback keeps line endings exactly.
  • Light Code 0.106.0: the handbook covers Fire Code's reach and parallel file tools.
  • Light Code 0.105.0: your keys can be brought into Fire Code with its "From IntelliJ / PyCharm" button; the Variables tab shows only your own variables; the handbook explains Fire Code, the new Windows app for several codebases at once; a secrets file shared by several processes no longer loses a key.
  • Light Code 0.101.0: Outlook waits out a busy Outlook instead of failing, recovers from a hung request, and finds old mail by date range.
  • Light Code now comes inside the plugin: every feature and fix of the matching VS Code and Node releases, with no npm download. Needs Node.js 18 or newer on the PATH.
  • New in Light Code: reply to a message or react to it and to its thinking; a wait tool for following a job or build until it is done; AutoSys status and details for many jobs at once; AutoSys through an API gateway, with a username and password where the gateway needs them.
  • No deprecated platform APIs (process listening uses ProcessListener).
  • The Light Code icon in the Marketplace, the plugin list and the tool window.
  • Installs into every IntelliJ IDEA and PyCharm release from 2023.2 on; 0.1.0 refused anything newer than 2025.1.
